quality.explanation: Evaluated as a midfielder: key passes and xA per 90 (creativity) plus interceptions + tackles won per 90 (defensive work), ranked against Premier League players in the same position group with 450+ minutes this season. Doesn't account for team style or opposition quality -- a low score can reflect a team's system as much as individual quality.

fit_read: This score sits at neutral because the listed stats give only partial, and partly conflicting, signals for a vertical, fast-transition / low-block, counter side, and several relevant aspects simply can't be judged from what's here. On the defensive side, the volume of tackles won (54) and interceptions (18) across 1,982 minutes indicates meaningful ball-winning activity, which is the kind of output a low-block, counter-oriented team leans on when regaining possession to launch transitions. However, the discipline line — 30 fouls committed against 10 drawn, plus 7 yellow cards — is a caution signal for a side that wants to sit deep and avoid conceding cheap set pieces and cards; that tension is worth the scout weighing rather than resolving here. On the ball, the attacking/creative stats are modest: 1 goal, 2 assists, 16 key passes, 13 crosses, xG 3.12 and xA 1.39 over the season. Low key-pass and cross volume is not obviously a problem for a direct, transition-first system that bypasses heavy possession buildup, but it also doesn't demonstrate the progressive passing or crossing a possession-leaning interpretation would want — so it reads as broadly neutral for this philosophy rather than a clear plus or minus. Critically, the supplied data contains no pace, sprint, or transition-speed metrics, so the speed-dependent side of a fast-transition fit cannot be assessed at all from these numbers, and no distance/positional or progressive-carry data is listed either. Because a genuine fit read for this club philosophy hinges substantially on transition speed and defensive-line behavior that aren't captured here, the honest signal is neutral (3) rather than a confident extreme. This is a fit signal for the scout to weigh alongside eye-test and role context, not a verdict.
